title: No Support of Sony Smartwatch 3 SW50 since latest DEV (2.8.2) version
body:
Hi I'm using the Sony smartwatch 3 SW50 in combination to AAPS. 

This works fine till version AAPS 2.8.2 master development, after implementing a newer google play service on the watch as it is described in
https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Usage/SonySW3.html

After creating 2.8.2 DEV in Android studio and installing it on the smartphone the watch isn't updated anymore.
So I tried to deploy the newest 2.8.2 watch.APK via ADB to the smartwatch without luck. The installing process cannot be done anymore. 

Using the 2.8.2 master version the installation of the watch.APK via ADB works fine.

Could someone please check, why the installation of the newest version of AAPS 2.8.2 on the SW50 isn't possible anymore ? Thanks

comments.body: @thomasmenges did you build the wear.apk with the same key(store)?

@AdrianLxM Hi Adrian, yes I did it with the same key(store). To be able to use the SW50 I did the workaround (ADB version update) on the watch. Using the AAPS version (master... of 2.8.2.) everything was  working fine. Since changing the code (DEV and the next coming 3.0...) Android studio cannot generate the wear.apk for the combined Sony watch anymore. Perhaps it's a problem in my environment but I'm struggling why the master version of AAPS is working well but the newest DEV versions not.

Perhaps you have the idea for that.

@dlvoy thanks for your information.
I'm sorry. I cannot check that  again,  because I switched to the new Samsung Watch 4.
Before that I stayed on the master 2.8.1 and that was ok on the SWR50. 

As you mentioned,  it seems that in RC3 the problems are solved.
So, in my opinion , this issue can be closed.
